summary: Deletes or keeps selected SOP points/primitives using number patterns, ranges, bounding volumes, normals, expressions, or backface tests.

key_params.name: negate
key_params.note: Delete selected geometry or delete non-selected geometry.

key_params.name: groupop
key_params.note: Number selection mode such as pattern, range, or filter.

common_gotchas: `negate` is the delete-selected/delete-non-selected control; `groupop` is only the number-selection mode.
Pattern syntax supports ranges, exclusions, and profile-style expressions, so literal strings can select much more than expected.
`keeppoints` can intentionally leave orphan points after primitive deletion.
key_concepts: Delete SOP deletes selected geometry or deletes everything except the selected geometry through `negate`.
`entity` selects whether deletion targets points or primitives, while `geotype` narrows primitive geometry type.
Selection can come from group patterns/ranges/expressions, bounds, normals, or backface camera tests.
`keeppoints` preserves points after primitive deletion for workflows that need orphan point data.
